resources.string: Choose when temporary colour and depth frames are deleted. Nothing is deleted without an explicit confirmation.
Data stays on this device until the app explicitly releases it.
Delete frames only if the reconstruction was published successfully.
Delete frames when the app explicitly releases the scan.
Encrypted frames can no longer be read after deletion.
Key deletion is unavailable because encrypted frames were not enabled or frames are kept.
Retained frames remain on this device.
Retained frames and the encryption key were deleted.
Only the encryption key was deleted. Existing encrypted frames can no longer be read.
